title: ただいま、風のなか · Home on the Breeze
description: A maple leaf tucked into a notebook, a suitcase full of stories, and someone waving beyond the station gates. Aya comes home from Canada to Japan, slips off her down coat, and finds joy in Chiba's cool breeze and a familiar voice saying welcome home.
caption: ただいま。ダウンを脱いだら、君のいる街の風。
